vulnerable_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

router = APIRouter(prefix="/quic/telemetry")

@router.get("/connections/{quic_connection_id}/stats")
async def get_quic_connection_stats(
    quic_connection_id: str,
    session_manager: WebTransportSessionManager = Depends(get_wt_session_manager),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    stats = session_manager.get_quic_stats(quic_connection_id)
    if not stats:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="QUIC connection stats not found")

    return {
        "connection_id": quic_connection_id,
        "rtt_ms": stats.rtt,
        "congestion_window_bytes": stats.cwnd,
        "packets_lost": stats.lost_packets,
        "remote_address": stats.peer_ip
    }
diagnosis: The QUIC telemetry route exposes low-level connection stats (round-trip time, congestion window, lost packets, and remote peer IP address) for any quic_connection_id. It performs no ownership check, enabling an attacker to monitor connection health and expose IP addresses of other connected clients.
